name: Shin Hai Gas Corporation
summary: Shin Hai Gas Corporation, established in 1966 and headquartered in New Taipei City, Taiwan, primarily operates as a natural gas supplier across the island. Beyond its core utility service, the company provides a variety of associated products, including emergency shut-off devices, advanced digital gas meters, cooking appliances, laundry dryers, and other essential safety equipment. Additionally, its portfolio extends to include telecommunication services. The firm distributes natural gas to an estimated 260,000 residential and commercial clients, focusing its operations within the Taipei County municipalities of Sanchong, Banqiao, and Xinzhuang.
